name: Alexia Davis
source:
First a freelancer thief, Alexia serves now as a spymistress for the enemies of the Emeroth Kingdom. She leads a band of mercenaries.
Anratis and her has been lovers in the past but they're not in good terms with each other anymore since she deceived and betrayed him.
